news.title: LISA, Anitta And Rema Bring Three Continents Together On World Cup Anthem "Goals"
news.lede: LISA, Anitta and Rema have made a World Cup song that represents three continents before anyone even kicks a ball. “Goals,” their collaboration for the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Album, brings together a Thai K-pop superstar, a Brazilian pop powerhouse and one of Nigeria’s biggest Afrobeats exports. That’s an extraordinary amount of star power for one recording, and Grammy-winning producer Cirkut has the job of making three musical worlds fit together. The result is a rhythm-driven pop track designed for an international audience that already knows the excitement of hearing thousands of strangers celebrate the same thing at once.

news.title: England win World Cup for players with cerebral palsy for the first time — BBC Sport
news.lede: England's national team won the World Cup for football players with cerebral palsy for the first time, defeating the United States 2-1 in the final in Atlanta, USA. This was reported by BBC Sport. Tournament hosts the United States took the lead after a corner kick three minutes before the end of the match. Sam Dewhirst equalised and took the game into extra time.

news.title: England win Cerebral Palsy World Cup for first time
news.lede: David Porcher scored the winner in the final for England. England have won the Cerebral Palsy World Cup for the first time by beating the United States 2-1 in a thrilling final. The hosts took the lead in Atlanta from a corner with three minutes left but Sam Dewhirst equalised to take the tie to extra time. And the Para Lions won it when David Porcher fired home after Dewhirst's shot was saved.

news.title: Kroupi Jr makes national team decision after rejecting World Cup place
news.lede: The Bournemouth star is eligible to play for three different countries due to family links. Born in France, his mother is of Portuguese descent whilst his father played for Ivory Coast. Kroupi Jr was offered an opportunity to play for Portugal at the 2026 World Cup, but turned it down. "Junior wanted to represent France, so we respect that," their former head coach Roberto Martinez said.
